sources.empty: region.go InitRegion(nil) returns nil; covertAPIRegionInfo(nil) marshals default repaired leader. All non-omitempty counters emitted.
sources.full: region.go InitRegion copies raw counters; HexRegionKeyStr uppercase; TestEasyJSONCompatibility asserts roundtrip for epoch, peers, counters, replication. Full values combine that example with source-derived max ID, binary keys, down/pending and buckets.
sources.reuse: InitRegion clears Buckets, only overwrites BucketVersion when >0.
sources.replication: fromPBReplicationStatus preserves present zero UNKNOWN; kvproto RegionReplicationState_name has 0 UNKNOWN, 1 SIMPLE_MAJORITY, 2 INTEGRITY_OVER_LABEL; unknown uses decimal.
sources.evidence_boundary: Only existing TestEasyJSONCompatibility executed in Go; other scenarios derived from read-only source, not runtime differential.
